• اقفز من الطائرة فوق الجزيرة، وافتح الم:
• Jump from the plane over the island and open your parachute.
• Collect weapons and ammo (F or the "Pick Up" button).
• Left joystick moves — push it up to lock sprint.
• Drag the right side of the screen to look; fire buttons also turn the camera.
• Keyboard: WASD move, Shift sprint, C crouch, Z prone,
   Space jump and vault over walls and windows, R reload, right mouse scope,
   Q and E lean, M map, B backpack, Ctrl show/hide cursor.
   (All keys can be changed in Settings → Key Bindings)
• H heal, Y boost, G grenade (release to throw), T grenade type.
• F near a deathbox opens its loot, and enters a car, bike or boat.
• Play matches to earn Gold and Season XP, and buy outfits in the Inventory.
